notes.title: The Crimson Dungeon Update (New Map + Enemies)
notes.content:
[p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650634/f1946120706bbdb5059071a9fd35d71fd99edc0e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650634/c72bebb1deefe96af79c6d912c433ee443b2f7bd.png"][/img][/url]

The Crimson Dungeon is the 2nd map location within Vanquish Evil. It features it's own unique dungeon atmosphere, immersed in a crimson stained lighting which is then faded into pure black darkness.[/p][p][/p][p]There are several dungeon coffins to open for items.

There features new enemies, one of which is called the Dungeon Crawler -- an undead cadaver that crawls along the dungeon floor.

Several new enemy types and bosses will be added to The Crimson Dungeon!

More updates on the way very soon! Thanks for playing!

GnarlyTree Games[/p]

notes.title: v0.2 (NEW MELEE CHARACTER ADDED! + VANQUISH EVIL SUMMER SALE DISCOUNT!)
notes.content:
[p][u]Vanquish Evil v0.2 (NEW MELEE CHARACTER ADDED!)[/u][/p][p][/p][p]A surprise content update for YOU!

- A new melee-focused character has been added to Vanquish Evil!

-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
WARRIOR SWORDSMAN
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-

- Powerful quick sword slashes!
- Upgrade sword slash damage.
- Upgrade sword slash knockback.
- Nearly ALL of the upgrades are compatible for each character.

Character Special Abilities:

Each character will have their own special attacks or abilities:

Wizard = Fire Missile (Fire Missile Damage, Fire Missile Cooldown, Fire Missile Speed).

Swordsman = Sword Slash and other sword-based attacks and abilities.


This update effectively doubles the content available by having a new character that can use the existing upgrades and create new synergies.

Thanks for playing Vanquish Evil, hope you enjoy the new character, and there's even more content on the way very soon! There will be quick hotfixes to quickly update and make adjustments (very often for the next 2 weeks, then assessing the direction from there).

At that point in development, 2 weeks from now:

- Designing new map locations.
- Designing multiple levels for the new map locations.
- More upgrades and abilities.
- More NPCs.
- More enemy minions.
- More bosses.

Thanks again for playing! Have fun!

GnarlyTree Games

OH AND BY THE WAY...

Hope you enjoy this 2 week discount sale Vanquish Evil :)

VANQUISH EVIL  DISCOUNT (JULY 28 - AUGUST 11)[/p]

notes.content:

- core gameplay loop now works as intended

INTENDED CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP:

1. start menu
2. map selection
3. "END RUN"
4. "GAME OVER"

3. and 4. go to:
5. stats screen (stats gained during in-game run)
and then back to:
6. start menu

This structure is now able to be used as a foundation to add more content (additional map locations, additional hero character selections, meta upgrades, etc)

Thanks for playing! Have fun! More content very soon (meta progression very soon).
